title: ThreatModel
description: ThreatModel schema from Varonis DatAlert API

id.description: Unique identifier for the threat model.

name.description: Display name of the threat model.

category.description: Category classification of the threat model aligned with MITRE ATT&CK framework.

severity.description: Default severity level assigned to alerts generated by this model.

source.description: Source or origin of the threat model such as built-in or custom.
